title: Toward a Characterization of Simulation Between Arithmetic Theories
summary: We study when a sound arithmetic theory $\mathcal S{\supseteq}S^1_2$ with polynomial-time decidable axioms has polynomial-size proofs of $Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}(n)$ for a true sentence $φ$. Our structural result characterizes the nonexistence of a length-optimal propositional proof system: it is equivalent to every such $\mathcal S$ failing to simulate $S^1_2{+}\mathsf{Exp}{+}φ_{BB}(k)$ for all sufficiently large $k$.
